photo.rotation-hint: Rotation keeps the selected aspect ratio and automatically crops away empty corners.
photo.non-destructive: The original is preserved. Only crop and rotation settings are saved.
photo.crop-instructions: Drag to move the selection; use the corners to resize. Hold Shift on desktop to lock movement to the initial horizontal or vertical direction. Arrow keys and the controls below also work.
photo.edit-error: Could not apply edits. The original is preserved.
photo.preview-error: Could not load the preview. Please check the theme settings.
photo.export-error: Export failed. Please check the settings and try again.

root.title: EXIF Frame

The amount of money you gave us was used to extend the Apple developer account and purchase coffee to help us develop it. We sincerely thank you for your support.
root.processing: it may take a long time depending on device specifications.
root.settings.maintain-exif: Keep EXIF Metadata (Only supported in JPEG)
lab.description: The experimental function may appear like the wind and disappear without a sound.
lab.collage-description: Create a collage with multiple photos.
lab.collage-options: You can set the top, bottom, left, and right margins and the space between photos.
please-check-your-photo-extension: Please check your photo file extension.
root.settings.lossless-hint: Saves PNG without quality or size adjustment. Draws the photo at original resolution and adds the frame and ratio padding around it. Saved crops, rotations, overlaid text and watermarks still apply. Arbitrary rotation requires interpolation; files may be large.
root.settings.original-resolution-hint: Adds the frame without resizing the photo. Export ratios add padding, and saved photo edits still apply.
root.settings.jpeg-quality-hint: JPEG at 100% keeps original resolution but still recompresses pixels. Choose PNG for lossless pixel storage.
photo.background-help: Applies only to this photo. Text and logos automatically match the background, overriding theme color settings.
photo.background-blur-help: Uses the original photo as a blurred background. Tint and text adapt to its brightness; the main photo stays unchanged.
photo.background-theme-help: Choose each photo’s background and automatic text colors via Background settings in the photo list.
root.settings.json-help: Save theme and export settings as JSON. Import replaces current settings and saves them automatically. Photos and per-photo edits/backgrounds are excluded and remain unchanged on import.
root.settings.json-import-error: Could not import settings. Check that this is a valid EXIF Frame settings JSON file.
root.settings.json-export-error: Could not save settings. Check the current setting values.
photo.settings-imported: Editing, background and metadata settings were applied to this photo.
photo.settings-import-error: Could not import photo settings. Check the photo settings JSON and original image dimensions.
photo.final-ratio-help: Includes the current theme’s EXIF footer in the ratio. Removes top and side photo margins and takes priority over export ratio and no-crop options for this photo. Recalculates when the theme changes.
photo.final-ratio-overlay-help: This theme has no separate EXIF footer. Photo overlays remain; surrounding frame margins and Cinema Scope letterboxes are removed.
photo.final-ratio-error: The crop is too small or the footer is too tall. Enlarge the crop or reduce the footer spacing.
root.settings.ratio-custom-help: Enter width and height, e.g. 1080:1440 or 1.91:1. Equivalent ratios are saved as simplified integers.
root.settings.ratio-custom-error: Enter positive values with up to two decimal places. Extremely wide, tall or precise ratios are not supported.
root.themes.exif-scale-help: Default: 100%. Scales the footer height, text, logos and spacing together. Photo side/top margins remain unchanged; final-ratio crops recalculate automatically.
